.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sqlite3,json,pathlib,collections
p=pathlib.Path('data/lexicon_builder/2026-11-12/ssl-explicit-genera/ssl-api-checkpoint/candidate.db')
c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro',uri=True)
print('state schema',list(c.execute('pragma table_info(definition_states)')))
ids=['wordnet:good:good.a.01','wordnet:bad:bad.a.01','wordnet:big:large.a.01','wordnet:small:small.a.01','wordnet:have:have.v.01','wordnet:have:own.v.01','wordnet:here:here.r.01','wordnet:leap:leap.n.01','wordnet:whisper:whisper.n.01','wordnet:explosion:explosion.n.01']
for eid in ids:
 row=c.execute('select domains,trace from definition_states where entry_id=?',(eid,)).fetchone()
 if row is None: print(eid,'ABSENT');continue
 domains,trace=map(json.loads,row)
 print(json.dumps({'entry_id':eid,'singleton_domains':{k:v for k,v in domains.items() if len(v)==1},'trace_type':type(trace).__name__,'trace_record_shapes':dict(collections.Counter(tuple(sorted(t)) if isinstance(t,dict) else type(t).__name__ for t in trace))},default=str))
c.close()
PY
